items.subject: Standalone core versus ORUDA compile-time and runtime dependency
items.resolution: Runtime registration is separated, but Maven modules, Core imports, tests and E2E must be physically separated.

items.subject: Incompatible state models
items.resolution: Machines are contract-mapped; Java persistence and transition migration remain.

items.subject: Product implementation complete claim versus official status
items.resolution: Completion claim was replaced with validator-slice and product Full-Chain status.

items.subject: Product E2E naming versus executed fixture scope
items.resolution: Names were corrected to Validator Fixture E2E, but Core and ORUDA runners remain combined.

items.subject: AI behavior validation name versus marker scan implementation
items.resolution: Rename the existing stage to policy marker scan or implement repeated agent/model/tool execution.

items.subject: RCA completion versus template-only inference
items.resolution: Template output must remain RCA_CANDIDATE until reproduction, first-failure and causal evidence are bound.

items.subject: Git source identity versus generic filesystem tree hashing
items.resolution: Use tracked Git objects for source identity, include untracked influence in the fail-closed check, and distinguish Git object IDs from SHA-256 artifact digests.

items.subject: README links versus actual document names
items.resolution: Broken links were replaced with current authoritative files.

items.subject: PR 17 completion claims versus candidate files
items.resolution: PR 17 was closed and integrated as a CANDIDATE_ONLY set with expert and independent gates on HOLD.

items.subject: Branch and PR governance versus direct main commit
items.resolution: Record the violation; all subsequent remediation must use audit/onsure-post-merge-self-audit-remediation-20260726 and a PR.

items.subject: Full requirements traceability claim versus 20 capability-group rows
items.resolution: Extract atomic requirements and separately track implementation and verification evidence.
